terminal.description: A shell that starts in the shop's top folder. Make what the jobs ask for, then list it to see it is there.

tasks.title: Make a folder for receipts
tasks.description:
Idris wants a folder called `receipts` in the top folder, for the card machine slips.

Check looks in the top folder for a folder with exactly that name.
nextSteps: Make sure you are in the top folder: `pwd`, or `ls` should show `today.txt`.
Make the folder with the command from the lesson.
Run `ls` and find `receipts` in the list.
hints: The lesson's command for a new folder is short for make directory.
`mkdir` takes the name of the folder to make, after a space.
Run `mkdir receipts` in the top folder.

tasks.title: Make month folders for the orders
tasks.description:
Idris will sort this year's orders by month. Inside `orders`, make a folder `2026`, and inside `2026` make three folders: `jan`, `feb` and `mar`.

Check looks for `orders/2026/jan`, `orders/2026/feb` and `orders/2026/mar`, all folders.
nextSteps: Look at what `orders` holds today with `ls orders`.
Make the three month folders inside `orders/2026`, in one command or three.
hints: You can make a folder inside another by giving its path, or by moving into the parent first.
`mkdir` takes several names at once, and `-p` also makes any missing folders on the way.
From the top folder, `mkdir -p` with the three paths `orders/2026/jan`, `orders/2026/feb` and `orders/2026/mar` makes them all.

tasks.title: Make a folder for poster ideas
tasks.description:
Hesper wants a folder for rough drawings inside `artwork`, called `poster ideas`, with the space.

Check looks for `artwork/poster ideas`. It also fails while a stray empty `poster` or `ideas` folder is left in `artwork` or the top folder, from a name the shell split at the space.
nextSteps: Remember from the last issue what the shell does with a space.
Make the folder inside `artwork`, keeping the space inside the name.
Run `ls artwork` and check there is one new name, not two.
If a split made two folders, remove them before you try again.
hints: A space separates the parts of a command, so a name with a space needs the same care as with `cd`.
Quotes or a backslash keep the space inside the name. An empty folder made by mistake goes away with `rmdir`.
Run `mkdir "artwork/poster ideas"` from the top folder.

tasks.title: Make an empty print queue file
tasks.description:
Hesper keeps a list of what to print next. Make an empty file called `print-queue.txt` in the top folder. It gets filled in later.

Check looks for a file with exactly that name in the top folder and checks that it is empty.
nextSteps: Go back to the top folder if you moved.
Make the empty file with the command from the lesson.
Run `ls -l print-queue.txt` and look at its size.
hints: `mkdir` makes folders. The lesson names another command for an empty file.
`touch` makes an empty file when the name does not exist yet.
Run `touch print-queue.txt` in the top folder.
